<thought>Based on the exact mass (114.068 Da) the molecular formula is C₆H₁₀O₂. The ¹³C NMR shows six distinct carbons: a carbonyl (~168 ppm), two sp² carbons (~144 ppm and ~130 ppm), and three aliphatic carbons in the 19–23 ppm range, which is consistent with an α,β‑unsaturated ester bearing a methyl group on the double bond and an ethoxy group. The SMILES that matches this formula and pattern is ethyl methacrylate: C=C(C)C(=O)OCC.</thought>
<final_answer>C=C(C)C(=O)OCC</final_answer>
